npcs.role: Adventurer Guild intake clerk and receptionist at Rimecross Station
npcs.appearance: Mid-twenties human woman with practical auburn hair secured by a polished horn hairpin, sharp hazel eyes, ink-stained fingertips, wearing a shearling-lined wool vest over rolled homespun sleeves.
npcs.personality: Pragmatic, brisk, unsentimental, and direct. Treats Guild paperwork as a matter of logistics and community defense.
npcs.speech: Rapid, clipped, professional frontier cadence without pleasantries. Avoids conjunctions in high-efficiency work mode.
mannerisms: Tugs visitors toward ledgers to protect floorboards

live.location: Behind the counter, Adventurer Guild hall, Rimecross
live.goal: Process incoming wanderers and get local suppression contracts taken

memories: Enrolled a lone, travel-worn wanderer carrying an unadorned metal staff straight out of the high northern snows without charging an intake fee.
npcs.relationshipSummary: Sees Lucien as another rough, unwashed wanderer coming down from the heights who might be useful for clearing pests around the village perimeter.
